visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled brown hair and a black pleated jacket is speaking directly to a microphone in a studio setting. Behind him is a dark, out-of-focus background with warm studio lighting hitting his side profile. (2) The screen displays a series of white text points on a black background, briefly cutting back to the man talking with animated facial expressions. An illustration of a man with glasses and a white t-shirt appears in a framed box. (3) A woman with dark hair and a translucent white top is shown talking. The screen overlaps with manga-style sketches featuring blue and pink character silhouettes. Red arrows and boxes highlight specific layout choices like 'Medium Shot' and 'Over-the-shoulder shot'. (4) The woman continues her explanation as the screen transitions between different manga formats: a traditional page layout, a four-panel vertical strip, and a graphic-plus-text version. Colorful cartoon characters are visible in these layouts. (5) The video ends with a black screen containing white and yellow text instructions and two downward-pointing arrows.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high clarity and a friendly professional tone. An upbeat, major-key electronic BGM starts immediately, sitting low in the mix. (2) A swift digital whoosh SFX occurs during a scene transition. The male voice continues narrating a story setup about a laptop and coffee. (3) A percussive 'pop' sound marks the introduction of the female guest. Her voice is clear, articulate, and well-enunciated. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) A series of UI-style 'ping' effects accompany graphic callouts on screen. The female voice explains technical manga layout logic while the background synth loop continues rhythmically.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Scenario -> Solutions/Demonstrations -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This educational short video aims to teach aspiring creators the visual storytelling logic of manga. By using a hypothetical comedic scenario involving the host, the guest manga artist demonstrates how different camera angles and panel layouts (page, 4-panel, etc.) fundamentally change the reader's perception and emotional connection to the story.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high-density information delivery typical of social-media knowledge sharing, using motion graphics and split-screen layouts to maintain visual engagement.
